title: Penetration Tester
description:
Penetration Tester (Associate) Location: Gurugram / Remote Experience: 0-3 Years Compensation: 3,00,000 Per Annum Employment Type: Full-Time 
About the Role OculusIT is looking for a highly motivated and passionate Associate Penetration Tester who is eager to build a career in offensive security. This role is designed for early-career cybersecurity professionals who possess a strong technical foundation, curiosity, and a willingness to learn advanced penetration testing techniques under the guidance of senior team members. Key Responsibilities Assist senior pentesters in security assessment engagements. Participate in internal and external vulnerability assessments. Perform reconnaissance and enumeration activities. Execute basic penetration testing tasks under supervision. Support web application and network security testing activities. Assist in vulnerability validation and evidence collection. Develop technical documentation and assessment notes. Participate in security research and proof-of-concept testing. Learn and apply offensive security methodologies. Support report generation and remediation verification activities. Required Knowledge Candidates should demonstrate understanding of: Networking Fundamentals TCP/IP DNS HTTP/HTTPS Operating System Concepts Windows Security Linux Administration Authentication Mechanisms Common Cyber Attack Vectors OWASP Top 10 Basic Active Directory Concepts Vulnerability Assessment Methodologies Desired Skills Exposure to any of the following is preferred: Kali Linux Burp Suite Nmap Nessus Wireshark Metasploit OWASP ZAP GitHub Security Projects Hack The Box TryHackMe PortSwigger Academy Certifications Preferred Any of the following certifications will be advantageous: Security+ CEH eJPT SC-900 Google Cybersecurity Certificate Certified in Cybersecurity (CC) Cisco CyberOps Associate Qualifications Bachelors degree or pursuing degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, IT, or related field. Strong desire to build a career in penetration testing. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Willingness to learn from senior security professionals. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Success Profile The ideal candidate is: Curious and self-driven. Passionate about ethical hacking. Active in cybersecurity learning platforms. Interested in offensive security and attack techniques. Eager to progress toward certifications such as OSCP, PNPT, or CRTO. Growth Path Associate Penetration Tester Penetration Tester Senior Penetration Tester Lead Penetration Tester Offensive Security Manager

title: Senior Penetration Tester
description:
NP : Immediate 
 JD : 
 The Penetration Tester, will provide broad and in depth knowledge to conduct offensive cyber operations across the organization globally In this role, you will conduct offensive security operations to emulate adversary tactics and procedures to test preventative, detective and response controls across the global technology landscape You will use your expertise to help influence technology decisions and work as part of a team to create consistent approaches to the offensive security processes and techniques Penetration Testing Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Operate a hands-on role involving penetration testing and vulnerability assessment activities of complex applications, operating systems, wired, wireless networks, and mobile applications/devices, Cloud(Azure, AWS, Google Etc) apps and softwares. Set up environment and maintain required tools needed for the team. Lead and manage Penetration Testing team and Supporting vendors to get qualitative deliveries to our customer. Develop and maintain security testing plans Able to automate penetration and other security testing on networks, systems and applications. Develop meaningful metrics to reflect the true posture of the environment allowing the organization to make educated decisions based on risk. Produce actionable, threat-based, reports on security testing results Act as a source of direction, training, and guidance for less experienced staff Consult with application developers, systems administrators, and management to demonstrate security testing results, explain the threat presented by the results, and consult on remediation Communicate security issues to a wide variety of internal and external customers to include technical teams, executives, risk groups, vendors and regulators Deliver the annual penetration testing schedule and conducting awareness campaigns to ensure proper budgeting by business lines for annual tests. Foster and maintain relationships with key stakeholders and business partners 
 Certificates: Must Have Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) 
 Good to have CREST Registered Penetration Tester (CRT) Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) Certification GIAC Certified Penetration Tester (GPEN) 
 Penetration Testing Expert Requirements and Qualification: Previous working experience as a Penetration Testing Expert for 9 year BE in Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, or similar relevant field In-depth knowledge of application development processes and at least one programing or scripting language (e.g., Java, Scala, C#, Ruby, Perl, Python, PowerShell) Must know about standard Industry security Practices (OWASP, SANS, etc), Knowledgeable about industry Security guidelines and compliance such as ISO27001, SOC2, HIPPA etc. Hands on experience with testing frameworks such as the PTES and OWASP. Applicable knowledge of Windows client/server, Unix/Linux systems, Mac OS X, VMware/Xen, and cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Critical thinker and problem solver Excellent organizational and time management skills
